## About This Assignment

This website is the presentation of an analysis of how pre‑course instructional videos could support student learning in COMP 110 at UNC.
The analysis considers both the potential benefits and limitations of pre‑course videos.

## Final Conclusions

My analysis suggests that many students may believe pre-lecture videos would be helpful, indicating strong interest in this for the future. I could not see a correlation between support for pre-lecture videos and student understanding, whihc means the results may not be perfectly conclusive.

I think my data supports the idea that implementing pre-lecture videos could improve student preparedness and comprehension. However, there are trade-offs to consider, including the time required for instructors to create these videos and the possibility that not all students will take advantage of them.

As a next step, the course could experiment with offering pre-lecture videos for a subset of topics and collect additional data on student engagement and performance. This would help determine whether the benefits outweigh the effort.
